svg.title: Ordnung minus each baseline, over the reads
svg.desc: Forest plot of the final run's paired differences over its 3 reads, Ordnung minus each baseline, in percentage points with 95 % intervals as the registered sentences print them: the letter-cluster bootstrap's, and for exact dates against the agent the non-inferiority test's bound. Ordnung minus LLM + rules tool, Exact date right: −6.0 [−11.1, −1.1]; Sign-flip test inverted into a 95 % bound, power 38 %. Ordnung minus LLM + rules text, Exact date right: −5.1 [−11.0, −0.3]; Sign-flip test over letter clusters, Holm within its family: sign-flip p = 0.090, Holm p = 0.180, power 21 %. Ordnung minus LLM only, Exact date right: +5.1 [−2.4, +12.2]; Sign-flip test over letter clusters, Holm within its family: sign-flip p = 0.214, Holm p = 0.214, power 93 %. Ordnung minus LLM + rules tool, Late or missed: +0.0 [−0.9, +0.9]; Described, not tested. Ordnung minus LLM + rules text, Late or missed: −0.6 [−2.3, +0.6]; Sign-flip test over letter clusters, Holm within its family: sign-flip p = 0.750, Holm p = 1.000, power 0 %. Ordnung minus LLM only, Late or missed: −5.4 [−10.3, −1.2]; Sign-flip test over letter clusters, Holm within its family: sign-flip p = 0.033, Holm p = 0.100, power 25 %.
svg.text: Ordnung minus each baseline, over the reads
Percentage points · 112 deadlines in 126 synthetic letters · 3 reads · holdout4 · claude-sonnet-5 · 95 % CI,

polygon.title: Ordnung minus LLM + rules tool, Exact date right: −6.0 [−11.1, −1.1] points, the non-inferiority test's 95 % bound

rect.title: Ordnung minus LLM + rules text, Exact date right: −5.1 [−11.0, −0.3] points; Holm p = 0.180

polygon.title: Ordnung minus LLM only, Exact date right: +5.1 [−2.4, +12.2] points; Holm p = 0.214
Ordnung minus LLM + rules tool, Late or missed: +0.0 [−0.9, +0.9] points; described, not tested

rect.title: Ordnung minus LLM + rules text, Late or missed: −0.6 [−2.3, +0.6] points; Holm p = 1.000

polygon.title: Ordnung minus LLM only, Late or missed: −5.4 [−10.3, −1.2] points; Holm p = 0.100

svg.text: Right of the line: Ordnung has more exact dates, or more late or missed ones. Exact dates against the agent: the non-inferiority test's 95 % bound, as its sentence gives it; every other interval is the bootstrap's.
